policy.partition_order: Delineate connected mechanically eligible patches meeting the area floor first. Partition remaining burn-eligible vegetation afterwards. This preserves feasible mechanical units when constructing the common management polygons.
policy.source_location: Chung et al. (2013), Table 4, printed page 1125, minimum treatment cluster 20 ha
policy.scope: A literature-based research scenario transferred from the OptFuels example. It is not a local operating standard or an empirically established universal minimum. The same floor for mechanical patches is a conservative study assumption.
policy.boundary_source_location: Section 5.4.1: operational burn units, existing infrastructure where feasible, and multiple vegetation types where access/topography constrain single-type units
policy.access: Every polygon must be connected through eligible land to an open USFS road or a mapped TIGER primary, secondary or local road. This is a mapped route screening assumption. TIGER records establish geometry, not permission or condition. Road permission, walking difficulty, holding capacity, site ownership and entry timing still require field review.
policy.boundaries: Mapped road cells separate compartments before subdivision. Other boundaries follow hard eligibility exclusions or generated shared cell edges. Generated edges require control-line design and review.
policy.programs: Whole polygons select no treatment or a linked set of the existing vegetation-specific histories. A third choice adds mechanically eligible forest patches that meet the area floor. Existing fuel responses and entry-specific operation costs are retained. Linking the histories is a decision restriction and does not synchronize their intervention dates.
policy.cost_scope: Retain the recorded per-hectare operation costs. New mobilization and control-line cost terms are not inferred without a supported basis.

guarantee: Every selected treated component contains an entire connected polygon and has at least the minimum area. Choices cannot remove cells inside a selected polygon.
reference_status: Geometry prepared. Recompute the full CA reference before optimization.
